blind.description: A small wooden jewelry box or trinket chest with an arched lid, supported by four ornate golden feet. It features golden corner reinforcements, a small front latch/keyhole, and a string of white pearls draped across the lid and hanging over the front edge. The textures are clean and stylized with polished reddish-brown wood, metallic gold accents, and lustrous pearls.
blind.from_above: A rounded rectangular brown lid bordered by golden corner brackets, with a curved U-shaped strand of white pearls resting across the top surface.
blind.height_vs_figure: Around 8 to 10 inches tall and about 1 foot wide, roughly 1/7 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
